title: Vietnamese Delights | Group Tour Package
highlights: Climb at "The Hands of The Gods," this architectural marvel features giant stone hands lifting a golden walkway, offering stunning panoramic views of the Ba Na Hills.
Experience the creativity of the intricate tunnel network used during the war, offering insight into the country's resilience and spirit at Cu Chi Tunnel.
Admire the ancient architecture, immerse in spirituality and witness traditional practices, with a glimpse into Vietnam's rich heritage of Pagodas.
Explore the Old Quarter's bustling streets, and discover the ancient Temple of Literature getting a glimpse into Vietnam's heart and soul.
From the stunning beaches to the historic Marble Mountains, Da Nang offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, cultural heritage and modern charm.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to the City of Soaring Dragon - Hanoi! Upon your arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel in Hanoi. After you reach, check-in and rest for a while. Later, you can head out to explore the town by visiting Lake of the Restored Sword Ho Hoan Kiem Lake, and Thap Ruo Tower or walk around the streets to try local cuisine and shop for traditional items. Finally, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: City Tour of Hanoi
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to explore the city of Hanoi. First, visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum then head to Quan Thanh Temple and Tran Quoc Pagoda, followed by a visit to Bat Trang pottery village. Next, explore the Ethnology Museum, the Temple of Literature and walk around the Old Quarter's 36 streets. Later, you can experience the Water Puppet Show [at an extra cost], an art that shares stories of harvests and water-related myths. After the show, transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Da Nang
days.desc: Pack your belongings, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport to board your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at the City of Bridges, you’ll be taken to your hotel, where you will check-in and rest for the day. You can plan the day at your own pace and head out to enjoy water sports at My Khe Beach, swim and snorkel at Red Beach or walk around the lanes of Con Market. Later in the evening, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge
days.desc: Today, you’ll be transferred from the hustle of Da Nang to the beauty of the Ba Na Hills. Start with a scenic cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. As you arrive at the summit, climb the Golden Bridge, known as "The Hands of The Gods,". Then, visit the Le Jardin D'Amour, Linh Ung Pagoda and the Debay Wine Cellar followed by a Vietnamese buffet lunch. After the fun-filled day, transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City
days.desc: Post check-out, you’ll be transferred to the Da Nang airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Once you arrive in the Pearl of the Far East, get transferred to your hotel, check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can make the most of your day with a visit to the Thien Hau Temple, and Reunification Palace or indulge in some retail therapy at Ben Thanh Market. Later, conclude the day with a return journey back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi Tunnel
days.desc: Today, you’ll be taken on a half-day sightseeing tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Begin with a visit to the Independence Palace, a key historical landmark. Next, admire the French-style architecture of the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, another example of French design followed by a visit to the poignant War Remnants Museum. Later, head to the Cu Chi Tunnels to uncover the hidden secrets of Vietnam's history. Post the sightseeing, transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
